items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: I remember him when you were a kid. ... Heard him play, oh yes. ... I just remember them, but I remember him, Bunk Johnson, coming over there. ... Well during that time Tommy played with them too.

ctx.x: Another trumpet player that left here very early, Tommy Ladner. Yeah, he died in New York. Did you ever know him?
Yes, Tommy, yes. He played trumpet there. Great blues king. Yeah.
Did you remember him when you were a kid?
